test_load_dataset_from_path: test loading a named dataset from a file path using the DatasetLoaderTest class
extract_dataset_helper: extract a downloadable dataset to an output path using the _extract_dataset helper function
get_metadata_from_path: get metadata including splits from a dataset directory path using dataset_loader.get_metadata_from_path
load_dataset_from_path: load a specific split of a dataset from a path using dataset_loader.load_dataset_from_path
extract_dataset_and_update_status: extract a dataset with image and metadata preprocessing using download_util.extract_dataset_and_update_status
